title: Ancillary Equipment
hero_lead: Everything a turnkey line needs around the main machines — boilers, cyclones, airlocks, magnets and ducting from one supplier.
body_paragraphs:
Turnkey means the unglamorous equipment arrives too: steam boilers for conditioning, cyclones and airlocks for aspiration, magnets protecting dies and rolls, and the ducting that ties the dust system together.

Specifying it all from one works means every flange, height and airflow is already coordinated before anything ships.

title: PLC & Control Panels
hero_lead: From a single batching panel to full-line automation — SEMZON builds the electrical brain of the plant in-house.
body_paragraphs:
SEMZON designs and wires PLC and MCC panels for every stage of the plant: batching and mixing first, then grinding, pelleting, cooling and packing brought under one operator screen.

Because panels are built in the same works as the machines, retrofitting automation into a running mill — ours or anyone's — is a routine job, not a science project.

title: Drum Cleaner
hero_lead: A rotating drum screen that scalps meals and ground materials, catching lumps, string and foreign matter ahead of batching.
body_paragraphs:
The rotary drum cleaner handles meals, ground grain and bulk ingredients that need gentle, continuous scalping rather than aggressive screening. Material passes through the rotating perforated drum; clean product falls through while oversize discharges at the end.

It is specified on SEMZON lines wherever soybean meal, canola and by-products enter the process.

title: Maize Pre-Cleaner
hero_lead: First defence for the whole plant — cobs, stones, string and oversize trash are pulled out before raw maize touches a machine.
body_paragraphs:
The CP pre-cleaner scalps incoming maize and grain at intake rates matched to your dumping pit and elevator, protecting hammer mills, conveyors and pellet dies from tramp material.

Combined with drum cleaning and magnets it forms the Stage 01 cleaning section of every SEMZON feed line.

title: Pellet Cleaner
hero_lead: Separates fines and broken pellets from finished product before packing, so only uniform pellets reach the bag.
body_paragraphs:
Positioned after cooling, the pellet cleaner strips fines and fragments from the finished pellet stream and returns them for re-pelleting, protecting pellet durability numbers and bag appearance.

It works alongside the SSLG crumbler and SFJH screener in the Stage 05 screening section of the line.
features: Removes fines and broken pellets before packing | Recovered fines returned for re-pelleting | Improves pellet durability index at dispatch | Simple screen change for pellet diameter

title: Bucket Elevator
hero_lead: Vertical lifting matched to your line rate and headroom — the workhorse that moves material between every stage of the plant.
body_paragraphs:
SEMZON bucket elevators lift grain, meal and pellets between process floors at capacities matched to the line, with belt speeds and bucket pitch selected per material.

Explosion-relief options, inspection doors and boot cleanout are detailed to keep maintenance simple and the elevator leg safe.
features: Capacities matched to line rate | Heights engineered to your building | Belt and bucket selection per material | Inspection and cleanout access as standard

title: Chain, Screw & Trough Conveyors
hero_lead: Horizontal and inclined transport — drag chain, screw and trough conveyors fabricated to the exact runs your layout needs.
body_paragraphs:
Every SEMZON line is tied together with conveyors fabricated in our own works: en-masse drag chains for gentle high-capacity runs, screws for metering and inclines, troughs where simplicity wins.

Dust-tight covers, intermediate discharge gates and wear liners are specified per duty.

title: Rotary Distributor
hero_lead: One inlet, many bins — motorised rotary routing that sends material to any silo or bin the recipe calls for.
body_paragraphs:
The rotary distributor swings a motorised inner spout across multiple outlet ports, routing incoming material to the selected bin under PLC control.

It removes manual slide-gate juggling above batching bins and finished-product silos alike.

title: Counterflow Cooler
hero_lead: Counterflow air against a settling pellet bed — hot pellets leave within 3–5 °C of ambient, hard, dry and ready to screen.
body_paragraphs:
The SKLN cooler draws ambient air upward through a descending bed of hot pellets, so the coolest air always meets the coolest product. Pellets exit within 3–5 °C of ambient with moisture flashed off, protecting durability and safe storage.

Level sensors and a slide-gate discharge keep bed depth — and cooling time — constant regardless of line rate from 6 to 30 t/h.

title: Belt Dryer
hero_lead: Multi-layer belt drying that takes extruded feed down to safe moisture gently and evenly — the partner machine to every extruder.
body_paragraphs:
The SHGW belt dryer carries extruded pellets across stacked mesh belts through controlled hot-air zones, drying to target moisture without case-hardening or breaking the product.

Steam and gas heating options match the utilities available at your site.

title: Dry Extruder
hero_tags: Full-fat soya | No boiler needed | Stage 04 · Extrusion
hero_lead: Friction-cooked extrusion without a boiler — the straightforward route to full-fat soya and small-line pet food.
body_paragraphs:
The SPHG dry extruder generates its cooking heat through barrel friction alone, so plants without steam can still produce full-fat extruded soya and simple pet rations.

It suits smaller operations and ingredient pre-treatment inside larger SEMZON lines.

title: Fish Feed Extruder
hero_tags: Floating & sinking | Aqua & pet | Stage 04 · Extrusion
hero_lead: Wet extrusion for floating and sinking aqua feed and pet food — cooked, expanded and shaped in one conditioned pass.
body_paragraphs:
The SMHS wet extruder steam-conditions the ration, then cooks and expands it through the barrel and die, producing floating or sinking pellets by recipe and die selection. Starch gelatinisation improves water stability and digestibility for fish, shrimp and pets.

Paired with the SHGW dryer and coating equipment it forms the core of SEMZON aqua and pet feed lines from 2 to 20 t/h.

title: Storage Tanks
hero_lead: Fabricated storage from one tonne to one hundred — raw material bins, finished-product silos and liquid tanks built in our Lahore works.
body_paragraphs:
SEMZON fabricates mild-steel storage tanks and bins from 1 to 100 tonnes: intake bins, batching bins above the mixer, finished-feed silos and liquid storage for oils and molasses.

Discharge geometry, level sensing and access are engineered per material so what goes in comes out — first in, first out, no bridging.

title: Hammer Mill
hero_lead: High-throughput grinding that sets up everything downstream — particle size decided here determines mixing accuracy and pellet durability three stages later.
body_paragraphs:
The SMSP hammer mill reduces cleaned maize, wheat and meal to a uniform 500–700 µm grind through a high-speed beater rotor and interchangeable screens. Screen apertures are swapped in minutes to match ration and species, so one mill serves mash, pellet and crumb programmes alike.

Every SMSP is fabricated and trial-run in our Lahore works, balanced as an assembly, and matched to your line's magnet, feeder and aspiration so the grinding section runs dust-tight at rated load.

title: Automatic Liquid Adding
hero_lead: Automatic, recipe-driven dosing of multiple liquids — oil, molasses, enzymes — weighed and delivered per batch by the control system.
body_paragraphs:
The automatic liquid adding system stores, weighs and injects several liquids per recipe, under PLC control, so each batch receives exactly what the formulation calls for without operator handling.

It closes the loop between the batching computer and the mixer for consistent finished-feed analysis.

title: Oil Adding Machine
hero_lead: Tank, pump and spray manifold that puts a measured shot of oil into every batch — evenly, on time, without puddling.
body_paragraphs:
The oil adding set meters fats and oils into the mixer through spray nozzles timed to the mixing cycle, so liquid lands on moving material and disperses evenly instead of streaking the batch.

Tank heating and insulated lines are specified for viscous fats in cold weather.

title: Twin-Shaft Paddle Mixer
hero_lead: Twin-shaft paddle action for the shortest cycles and the gentlest handling — built for high-liquid and fragile-ingredient rations.
body_paragraphs:
The SMSJ twin-shaft paddle mixer fluidises the batch between counter-rotating paddle shafts, reaching CV ≤ 5% in an even shorter cycle than ribbon mixing while treating heat-sensitive and fragile ingredients gently.

It is the mixer of choice where high liquid percentages — molasses, fat, oil — would overload a ribbon machine.

title: Ribbon Mixer
hero_lead: Batch mixing to a coefficient of variation of 5% or better in a 90–120 second cycle — the accuracy heart of the batching section.
body_paragraphs:
The SMHY horizontal ribbon mixer blends macro ingredients, micro-doses and added liquids into a homogeneous batch in 90–120 seconds, holding CV at or below 5% across the 250–2000 kg batch range.

Full-length bomb-door discharge empties the batch fast and clean, keeping cycle times tight and cross-contamination low between rations.

title: Packing Scales
hero_lead: Weigh, fill, stitch, dispatch — finished feed into accurate 25 and 50 kg bags at the pace of the line.
body_paragraphs:
SEMZON packing stations weigh finished feed into 25 or 50 kg bags with load-cell accuracy, then carry them across a stitching conveyor to the dispatch bay.

Bagging rate is matched to line capacity so packing never becomes the bottleneck at the end of a good production day.

title: Feed Pellet Mill
hero_tags: 2–35 t/h | Ring die Ø350–768 mm | Stage 04 · Pelleting
hero_lead: The heart of the plant — steam-conditioned mash pressed through precision ring dies at 80–85 °C, from 2 to 35 tonnes every hour.
body_paragraphs:
The SZLH series covers the full SEMZON feed-line range with ring dies from Ø350 to Ø768 mm. Mash is conditioned with saturated steam to 80–85 °C — up to triple-pass conditioning on larger frames — then pressed into dense, durable pellets.

Gear-driven transmission, quick die clamping and roller adjustment keep changeovers short, and every die and roller set is supported with spares from the Lahore works for the life of the machine.

title: Pellet Crumbler
hero_lead: Corrugated-roll crumbling that turns cooled pellets into uniform starter and grower crumbs — up to four-roll configurations.
body_paragraphs:
The SSLG crumbler passes cooled pellets between corrugated rolls to produce crumbs for young birds and small species, with roll gap adjustment setting crumb size on the run.

A bypass flap sends whole pellets straight through when crumbs are not required, so one line serves both products.

title: Vibration Screener
hero_lead: Rotary vibration grading that splits pellets and crumbs into precise size fractions — uniform product forward, everything else back.
body_paragraphs:
The SFJH screener grades cooled pellets and crumbled product across multiple decks, sending on-size feed to packing and returning fines and oversize for reprocessing.

Deck screens are matched to your crumb sizes and pellet diameters, and swap quickly between production runs.
